title: Quant Hub Repo Public Vocabulary
purpose: Define stable project terms, evidence maturity levels, and claim boundaries for public technical review.

terms.allowed_meaning: The technical platform and research program represented by this repository.
The quantitative-market experimentation and measurement lane within LumenCore.
The orchestration and context layer that connects protocols, evidence builders, dashboards, and human gates.
The hash, manifest, provenance, negative-result, and reproducibility controls used to preserve an evidence record.
The explicit human decision required before submissions, certifications, spending, account changes, external sends, legal actions, or live orders.
The controlled translation of externally accepted technical metrics into bounded economic scenarios with named assumptions and owners.
A registered candidate transform, routing rule, model family, or feature construction evaluated under a stated protocol.
The highest-ranked candidate inside a named dataset, split, metric, baseline set, and evaluation run.

evidence_maturity.label: concept registered
evidence_maturity.minimum_evidence: A named concept, owner, scope, and prohibited claims.

evidence_maturity.label: implemented and tested
evidence_maturity.minimum_evidence: Runnable code, deterministic tests, and an identified input contract.

evidence_maturity.label: frozen synthetic benchmark
evidence_maturity.minimum_evidence: Preregistered synthetic protocol, frozen split, named baselines, metrics, and preserved failures.

evidence_maturity.label: source-conditioned replay
evidence_maturity.minimum_evidence: Hashed source artifacts, reproducible replay, named baselines, wins and non-wins, and explicit limitations.

evidence_maturity.label: prospective public-data evaluation
evidence_maturity.minimum_evidence: A frozen protocol evaluated only on observations arriving after the freeze, with complete settlements and preregistered gates.

evidence_maturity.label: independent external validation
evidence_maturity.minimum_evidence: A named independent organization evaluates held-out or field data, accepts the metric and protocol, and provides a dated validation receipt.

level_policy.rule: A component may claim only the highest level supported by its own evidence. Repository-wide language must use the lowest level needed for the stated claim.
level_policy.level_5_gate: No Level 5 claim is allowed without a named external validator, independent data or field setting, accepted metric, dated receipt, and preserved artifact hashes.

patent_boundary: This public vocabulary does not state what any filed patent claim covers. Counsel must compare the official filed claims and specification with dated evidence and later-developed concepts.
public_private_boundary: Public builders may report metadata and public-safe evidence only. They must not read, copy, hash-list, or publish private patent-vault contents, credentials, personal identifiers, or privileged communications.
